notes: Hand-authored workspace-default binding for the Assumptions & Gaps v1 docx shell. seed: {"name":"Assumptions & Gaps","version":"v1","kind":"ASSUMPTIONS_GAPS"}. The Assumptions & Gaps deliverable is mostly a human-authored artefact: open questions, dependencies, and the gap-by-gap narrative are too engagement-specific for the engine to invent. The engine sticks to project / engagement / scenario metadata on the cover, drops the estimation engine's `totals.assumptions` text into Section 1, frames Section 4 with the live findings/risks/recommendations counts so the reviewer can see how thin the evidence base still is, and seeds Section 5 with the `recommendations.bulletList` excerpt. Everything else (open questions, dependency list, gap narrative, next-activity schedule) stays as bracketed prompts for the human author to fill in.

entries.note: Cover > Project metadata > Scenario name from the latest estimate.
Section 1 > Key assumptions — engine's assumptions text from the chosen scenario.
Section 4 > Gaps in evidence > Findings recorded so far.
Section 4 > Gaps in evidence > Risks identified.
Section 4 > Gaps in evidence > Recommendations drafted.
Section 2 > AI-written open-question bullets. Replaces a static framing paragraph.
Section 5 > AI-written discovery activities. Replaces the previous recommendations.bulletList raw dump.
